modules.name: shared-types
owns: LeaveStatus enum (DRAFT | SUBMITTED | APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED)
LeaveType enum (annual | sick | emergency | unpaid | maternity | paternity)
AuditAction enum (CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE | APPROVE | REJECT)

recommended_phases.title: Phase 1: Shared types
recommended_phases.rationale: Zero-dependency foundation. Place LeaveStatus, LeaveType, AuditAction enums and BaseEntity type in src/shared/types/. Every downstream module imports these.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2: Employee module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends only on shared types. Provides employee lookup, manager resolution, and active-status checks that leave, balance, and policy modules all consume.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3: Policy module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on shared types. Defines leave policies, entitlement rules, and validation logic. Balance and leave modules depend on it.

app_notes: Layer boundaries: presentation (controllers, routes) → application (services) → domain (entities, repository interfaces) → infrastructure (repository implementations, DB). Dependencies flow inward. Every service interface is declared before its implementation. No circular dependencies — verified: leave→{balance,policy,employee,audit,notification,shared/types}; balance→{policy,employee,shared/types}; policy→{shared/types}; employee→{shared/types}; audit→{shared/types}; notification→{shared/types}. Shared value types (LeaveStatus, LeaveType, AuditAction, BaseEntity) placed in src/shared/types/ — used by multiple modules and carry no owned behavior.
auth_contract: request.user: { id: string; role: UserRole }; UserRole = 'employee' | 'manager' | 'hr_admin'; JWT bearer verified by auth middleware populating request.user; RBAC enforced by requireRole(...) route guard at the Fastify route level — never inline in service or controller methods. Leave endpoints: create/submit/cancel → employee; approve/reject → manager; list all / policy management → hr_admin.
error_response_contract: errors return { error: string; code: string; details?: unknown[] }; validation failure → HTTP 400 ({ error: 'Validation failed', code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', details: [...] }); authentication failure → 401 ({ error: 'Unauthorized', code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' }); authorization failure → 403 ({ error: 'Forbidden', code: 'FORBIDDEN' }); not found → 404 ({ error: 'Not found', code: 'NOT_FOUND' }); insufficient balance → 422 ({ error: 'Insufficient leave balance', code: 'INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE' }); policy violation → 422 ({ error: 'Leave policy violation', code: 'POLICY_VIOLATION', details: [...] }).
